discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_18/section_18.9.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS` and Audit control `section_18/section_18.9/cis_18.9.25.6.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2022-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win22cis_laps_passwordagedays_value is the value backed by the following registry REG_DWORD value of 30 or fewer. This setting controls the maximum password age of the managed local administrator account. The defaults setting is 30 days. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled: 30 or fewer.
odvs.name: laps_passwordagedays_value

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "18.9.25.6 | PATCH | Ensure Password Settings: Password Age (Days) is set to Enabled: 30 or fewer"
  when:
    - win22cis_rule_18_9_25_6
    - prelim_win22cis_is_domain_member
  tags:
    - level1-memberserver
    - rule_18.9.25.6
    - patch
    - laps
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "18.9.25.6 | PATCH | Ensure Password Settings: Password Age (Days) is set to Enabled: 30 or fewer | Set Variable"
      when: win22cis_laps_passwordagedays_value <= 30
      ansible.windows.win_regedit:
        path: HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\LAPS
        name: PasswordAgeDays
        data: "{{ win22cis_laps_passwordagedays_value }}"
        type: dword

    - name: "18.9.25.6 | AUDIT | Ensure Password Settings: Password Age (Days) is set to Enabled: 30 or fewer | Warning Check For Variable Standards"
      when: win22cis_laps_passwordagedays_value > 30
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid laps Password Age (Days) for win22cis_laps_passwordagedays_value. Please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "18.9.25.6 | AUDIT | Ensure Password Settings: Password Age (Days) is set to Enabled: 30 or fewer | Warn Count"
      when: win22cis_laps_passwordagedays_value > 30
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '18.9.25.6'
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
